plays.summary: A white midfielder wins a bouncing ball in the right half and switches play diagonally toward the left flank near halfway.

players.note: Should step closer to challenge the first contact and prevent an easy switch across midfield.
Like Toni Kroos, quickly spots the open space on the weak side and switches play cleanly.

plays.summary: The white left-back controls the diagonal ball on the halfway line under pressure and threads a clean pass down the left touchline.

players.note: Angle the pressing run to cut off the outside line rather than overcommitting inside.
Like Andrew Robertson, cushions the bouncing ball cleanly and plays forward into stride along the touchline.

plays.summary: White recycles possession back through their defense to the goalkeeper, whose long clearance under pressure bounces out of play on the far touchline.

players.note: Good pressing effort to force the goalkeeper into a rushed long kick; curve the run slightly earlier to block the central lane.
Smartly retains possession by turning back inside rather than forcing a low-percentage duel.
Keep head up before playing back so a midfield option can be found instead of putting the goalkeeper under pressure.
Aim the clearance further inside the touchline to keep the ball in play for the wingers.

plays.summary: Play pauses as the assistant referee signals a throw-in on the far side and players reset their positions.
Navy takes the throw-in on the far side, white clears upfield, and navy recovers possession near the far touchline at midfield.

players.note: Deliver the throw-in cleanly to a teammate's feet or space behind the pressing defender.
Reads the second ball well to regain possession near midfield.
Compete firmly on the throw-in, but look for a composed midfield pass rather than clearing blindly.

plays.summary: White intercepts navy's build-up near the far touchline and launches a long ball into the navy penalty area that the navy goalkeeper claims cleanly.

players.note: Check over the shoulder before passing inside so the ball is not turned over in midfield.
Like Alisson Becker, commands the penalty area decisively and claims the bouncing through ball ahead of the striker.
Great anticipation to win possession; take a fraction off the long pass so the striker can reach it before the goalkeeper.

plays.summary: The navy goalkeeper rolls the ball out to his centre-back to start a patient build-up from the back.

players.note: Calmly starts play short to keep possession rather than kicking long unnecessarily.
Opens body to receive and moves the ball smoothly toward the right-back.

plays.summary: A white forward presses intensely down the right touchline, forcing the navy right-back to shield under heavy pressure before composing himself and playing back to his goalkeeper.

players.note: Like Kyle Walker, stays composed under a fierce touchline press and uses his body well to protect possession and reset.
Provides a clean backpass angle to help his right-back escape the press.
Relentless pressing effort to pin the defender near the touchline; hold position slightly closer to block the backpass lane next time.

plays.summary: The navy goalkeeper switches the ball out to his left-back, whose pass forward along the far flank is cut out in midfield.

players.note: Smartly switches the point of attack away from the touchline press.
Scan inside options before playing blindly down the line into an outnumbered area.

plays.summary: White intercepts in midfield and works the ball wide for an accurate cross that a white striker heads on target, forcing a clean catch from the navy goalkeeper.

players.note: Like Thibaut Courtois, tracks the cross well, sets his feet early, and holds the header cleanly with zero rebound.
Like Luka Modric, reads the loose pass immediately and releases the winger in space.
Like Trent Alexander-Arnold, whips an inviting early cross into the danger zone for the striker.
Like Olivier Giroud, attacks the cross bravely and directs a firm header on target.

plays.summary: The navy goalkeeper waits for his team to push up before punting long upfield, where the second ball goes out of play on the far touchline.

players.note: Direct the long punt slightly closer to the central forward rather than toward the touchline.

plays.summary: White restarts with a throw-in on the far side and patiently passes around navy's midfield block to advance toward the attacking third.

players.note: Stay compact as a unit and force white backward rather than diving into challenges.
Starts play cleanly from the throw-in into midfield.
Moves the ball briskly with crisp touches to probe for an opening.

plays.summary: A white attacker drives down the far right channel and fires an angled shot that is deflected behind for a corner kick.

players.note: Tracks the runner well and gets a crucial deflection to prevent a clean shot across goal.
Like Mohamed Salah, accelerates into the right channel and gets a dangerous strike away under pressure to win a corner.

plays.summary: White prepares to take a corner kick from the far right as both teams organize their marking inside the navy penalty area.
White swings a dangerous corner kick into the six-yard box, sparking a goalmouth scramble where the navy goalkeeper and defense block a close-range effort and clear.

players.note: Like David Raya, stays brave in a crowded six-yard box and blocks the close-range effort.
Reacted first to the loose ball in front of goal to clear the immediate danger.
Like Kevin De Bruyne, delivers a menacing corner right into the six-yard corridor of uncertainty.
Good movement to attack the delivery, though needed a slightly cleaner contact to beat the goalkeeper.

plays.summary: Navy clears the rebound long upfield, and the ball bounces past halfway and out over the far touchline.

players.note: Clears decisively with height and distance to relieve pressure after the corner.

plays.summary: Play pauses for a throw-in on the far side while players walk into position and coaches shout instructions.
White launches a long throw-in down the far flank that is flicked on, but a navy defender wins the bouncing ball and clears it out for another throw.

players.note: Like Virgil van Dijk, reads the flick-on early and clears decisively before the white striker can latch onto it.
Delivers a long throw-in that puts navy's backline under immediate aerial pressure.
Good flick-on attempt, though try to angle it further inside toward the supporting striker.

plays.summary: Play stops near the far touchline as substitutions and coaching instructions take place before white prepares to throw in.
From a white throw-in, a midfielder threads a sharp through ball into the right channel for the white striker, whose low shot is parried behind by the navy goalkeeper for a corner.

players.note: Track the striker's diagonal run earlier so he cannot get behind the backline from a simple throw-in.
Like Jan Oblak, narrows the angle quickly and makes a strong parry to push the shot behind for a corner.
Like Martin Odegaard, takes the ball cleanly off the throw-in and splits the defense with a perfectly weighted through ball.
Like Erling Haaland, times the run behind the defense well and strikes cleanly across goal to test the keeper.

plays.summary: Both teams crowd into the navy penalty area as white sets up for a corner kick from the far right.
White whips a corner kick into the crowded six-yard box where a white attacker finishes from close range to score a goal.

players.note: Command the six-yard box aggressively on inswinging corners or organize defenders on the posts to prevent close-range finishes.
Stay body-to-body with attackers inside the six-yard box and attack the first ball decisively.
Like Bukayo Saka, delivers a pinpoint corner kick right into the dangerous six-yard area to create the goal.
Like Gabriel Magalhaes, attacks the six-yard box with determination and buries the finish through traffic.

plays.summary: Players jog back to their halves as navy sets up for the kickoff following white's goal.
Navy restarts from the center circle, passes back to defense, and launches a long diagonal pass up the left wing contested near the touchline as the clip ends.

players.note: Cleanly lays the kickoff back to build an immediate response.
Looks to stretch white quickly with a long diagonal, though a slightly softer loft would give the winger an easier first touch.
Closes down the diagonal ball quickly to contest possession near the touchline.
